capabilities: build tabbed screens from movable, resizable tiles
pin whole notes or note sections and maps onto tiles
show live party cards and run a combat bar
roll dice and hand out loot to characters
play music, ambience and sound effects from buttons
extras: Not yet in the Community plugins list; installed via BRAT or manually from releases. Unofficial fan project; no D&D rules text is included.
problem: Running a tabletop game in Obsidian scatters references, party stats, dice, timers and music across separate tabs and plugins, with no single screen to play from.

relations.evidence: With One DnD Character Sheet and Roll for Initiative it also knows your party's HP
With Roll for Initiative, a combat bar shows the round, whose turn it is
With Dice Roller installed, its dice are used instead.
Fantasy Statblocks | Statblocks in pinned notes and popups
Maps from TTRPG Tools – Maps fill their tile and keep working
In-game time from TTRPG Tools – Time: today's date and hour
Same clock format: clocks move freely between notes and the screen
Pin any Randomness table as a button and click to roll.

summary: Tabbed GM screen built from draggable tiles: pinned notes and maps, live party stats, dice tray, combat bar, session notes, soundboard, clocks and random tables.
